categories.main_business_segments: Chaozhou Three-Circle (Group) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the electronic ceramic components industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of electronic components and advanced materials. Its main product lines include communication components, electronic components and materials, and new materials, serving sectors such as electronics, communication, consumer electronics, industrial electronic equipment, and new energy. The company also develops solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) systems and multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 50 years of R&D experience in electronic ceramic components, mastering ceramic material preparation, forming, sintering technologies, and precision mold design. It emphasizes innovation in MLCC technology focusing on miniaturization, high capacitance, high frequency, high reliability, and high voltage. The company also develops SOFC technology, achieving breakthroughs in power density and efficiency, and advanced ceramic packaging substrates for 5G and other applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in electronics, telecommunications, consumer electronics, industrial control, automotive electronics, and new energy sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with products applied in data centers, cloud computing, IoT, and emerging digital services. Major customers include top-tier firms in these industries, with the top five customers accounting for approximately 17.55% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant production and R&D facilities in Guangdong (Chaozhou), Sichuan (Nanchong, Deyang), Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Suzhou. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong, Germany, the Netherlands, Malaysia, the United States, South Korea, India, and Thailand, serving global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chaozhou Three-Circle operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of electronic components and advanced materials. It controls the entire value chain from R&D, production to sales, supplying components to downstream manufacturers in electronics and communication industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and scale expansion to strengthen its core product competitiveness. R&D focuses on advanced MLCC products with enhanced performance parameters, SOFC systems for energy transition, and new ceramic materials for emerging industries like new energy and automotive electronics. It invests heavily in research institutes and talent development to support sustainable, high-quality growth and aims to become an internationally influential advanced materials expert.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electronic components and materials, including MLCCs, communication components, and fuel cell systems. The company employs direct sales and distribution channels, with a majority of sales conducted via direct sales. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the electronic ceramic components industry, recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and manufacturing champion. It competes in a highly competitive market with increasing domestic substitution of imported components. Its technological breakthroughs and diversified product portfolio help maintain a stable market position against both domestic and international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.73 billion, an 11.21% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.58 billion, up 5.07%. It has a total asset base of over RMB 21.8 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 18.23 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. The company increased R&D investment by 20.71% to RMB 545.8 million, supporting its innovation-driven growth strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chaozhou Three-Circle emphasizes its long-standing expertise and technological leadership in electronic ceramic materials and components, offering high-value, high-performance products such as ultra-high capacitance MLCCs and efficient SOFC systems. Its competitive differentiation lies in continuous innovation, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and a comprehensive product portfolio tailored to meet evolving customer needs in high-tech and emerging industries, supported by strong R&D and quality management.
